reuse.why: The new action reuses budget eligibility, sign conversion, batching and undo abstractions, but implements tag detection instead of using extractTagsFromText.

duplication.why: Five actions repeat the same category query and row-type extension rather than sharing category loading.

placement.why: Budget policy remains in budget actions and method registration follows the existing app layer, although tag interpretation belongs in the shared tags abstraction.

scope.why: The changes address the requested actions and exclusions, with only incidental unused-variable edits in an unrelated test setup.

maintainability.why: Centralized eligibility keeps policy changes manageable, but repeated queries, ad hoc tag interpretation and weak category types warrant cleanup.

bypasses_abstraction.where: actions.ts: shouldWriteMonthBudget uses toLowerCase().includes('#fixed') instead of shared/tags.ts extractTagsFromText.

disguised_duplication.where: actions.ts: shouldWriteMonthBudget reshapes existing shared tag interpretation into an inline substring check.

abstraction_drift.where: shouldWriteMonthBudget replaces its action discriminator with the requested includeHiddenCategories flag; all six month-wide actions continue through the helper.
